# WheelSense Story Direction (English Master)

## Opening Scene
- Visual (WebGL): Dark background with particles forming a rotating wheelchair wheel at center.
- Text: "It started with a simple rotation..."
- Scroll Action: The wheel softly disperses, then reassembles into Phase 1.

## Phase 1: YES Wheelchair - Digitization
- Concept: Physical to Digital.
- Visual Style: Neon green wireframe wheelchair with a scanning grid.
- HUD Chips: Distance: 5.2 km, Safety: Active, Fall Detected: False.
- Narrative: Wheelchair motion becomes measurable data for health and safety.
- Tech Focus: IoT sensors, movement metrics, fall detection.

## Phase 2: ALL Wheelchair - Interaction
- Concept: Digital to Interaction.
- Visual Style: Shift from green to purple and magenta with cyber interaction effects.
- Camera Mood: Driver perspective feeling, as if users control a game world.
- Motion Behavior: Scroll interaction nudges wheelchair state and interactive overlays.
- Narrative: Rehabilitation becomes engaging through motion-controlled exergaming.
- Tech Focus: Motion tracking, game control mapping, user engagement.

## Phase 3: Marathon and Racing - Expansion
- Concept: Room to World.
- Visual Style: Fast-moving global map and telemetry lines.
- Effects: Speed streaks, GPS-like coordinate streams, satellite communication cues.
- Narrative: Wheelchair analytics scale from indoor sessions to real race tracks.
- Tech Focus: GPS + 4G modules, real-time telemetry, long-range tracking.

## Phase 4: WheelSense - Intelligence
- Concept: Vehicle to Companion.
- Visual Style: Neural network structures, computer-vision boxes, smart-home icons.
- Environment: Clean smart-home atmosphere with contextual AI signals.
- Narrative: The system understands context and supports daily independence.
- Tech Focus: AI, computer vision, voice interaction, smart-home integration.

## Ending Scene
- Visual: Neural links from Phase 4 condense into the WheelSense identity.
- Call to Action: "Explore Our Projects" and "Meet the Team".

## UX and Motion Notes
- Sticky Stage: Keep the 3D visual pinned while narrative panels scroll.
- Color System:
  - Phase 1: Green
  - Phase 2: Purple
  - Phase 3: Orange
  - Phase 4: Blue
- Timeline Feedback: Right-side progress dots for phase awareness.
- Scroll Rhythm: Smooth transitions between phases with clear state changes.
